description: Open a Rooms Agent Pay room for a goal with a budget (USD) and an approval line. Returns one ready-to-pay link the human opens to fund it with PayPal or a card (SANDBOX: no real money). Unspent budget stays in the room as credit for the next hire.

approval_line.description: Hires above this USD amount wait for the owner's OK

cap.description: Budget in USD to put in the room (minimum applies, e.g. 25)

email.description: Funder email (optional; first room's fee is waived for a new email)

goal.description: What the room should get done

name: create_room
